;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Air Defense Force]] damages an [[Israel]]i aircraft and thwarts an Israeli missile strike on the [[Tiyas Military Airbase]] (T-4 Airbase) in the [[Homs Governorate]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-airbase/syrian-state-media-says-air-defenses-hit-israeli-plane-thwart-missile-strike-idUSKBN1JY0WL (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Amesbury poisonings]]
**A British woman dies after being exposed to the [[Novichok]] nerve agent several days earlier in [[Amesbury]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/amesbury-poisoning-dawn-sturgess-45-dies-after-exposure-to-nerve-agent-novichok-2018-07-08/ (CBS News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Japan floods]]
**The death toll from heavy rains in [[Japan]] rises to 94, with over 50 people still reported missing. [https://japantoday.com/category/national/Rescuers-search-for-survivors-of-floods-as-death-toll-nears-100 (''Japan Today'')]
*[[Tham Luang cave rescue]]
**Four boys are rescued from the cave. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/08/thailand-cave-rescue-begins-four-boys-freed (''The Guardian'')] [https://edition.cnn.com/asia/live-news/thai-cave-rescue-live-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Çorlu train derailment]]
**A train en route to [[Istanbul]] from [[Bulgaria]] derails in [[Tekirdağ Province]], [[Turkey]], killing 24 people and injuring 73. [http://www.startribune.com/train-derailment-in-turkey-causes-deaths-and-injuries/487601771 (''Star Tribune'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-44757515 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] calls for [[North Korea]] to follow [[Vietnam]]'s path in overcoming past hostilities with the [[United States]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/jul/08/mike-pompeo-north-korea-denuclearization-talks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Eritrea–Ethiopia summit]]
**Ethiopian Prime Minister [[Abiy Ahmed]] meets with Eritrean President [[Isaias Afwerki]] in [[Asmara]] and they pledge to restore [[Eritrea–Ethiopia relations|diplomatic relations]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/ethiopia-eritrea-restore-diplomatic-relations-1.4738578 (CBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Human rights in Iran]]
**[[Iran]]ian police arrest a number of users for posting illegal content on [[Instagram]], including a famous blogger named Maedeh Hojabri. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/08/iran-woman-arrested-instagram-video-dancing (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[David Davis (British politician)|David Davis]] resigns as the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union]] amid disagreements with Prime Minister [[Theresa May]] over [[Brexit negotiations]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-44761056 (BBC)]
*[[2016–present purges in Turkey|Purges in Turkey]]
**[[Turkey]] purges more than 18,500 government workers a day before [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] is sworn in as executive president. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-07-08/turkey-purges-more-than-18-000-civil-servants-in-latest-decree (Bloomberg)]
